text:
ava: Heads up — Riverside reporting a sudden p99 spike on embeddings (route: /v1/embeddings) starting ~03:20 UTC, p99 jumped ~5-10x. Customer seeing timeouts in their batch job. Anyone on call?

sam: taking this. do we have a tenant id or example request ids?

ava: tenant_id=tenant-riverside-9. sample request ids: req-8d7f, req-a2b3. attaching quick note from customer: "large upsert batches, many repeated short documents, lots of identical text"

ops-bot: ALERT: embeddings-p99 tenant-riverside-9 > 1500ms (threshold 800ms). window: 5m

marta: linked dashboards https://console.redwood.ai/d/embeds/tenant/tenant-riverside-9?from=now-30m show sharp tail starting 03:18 UTC. queues on shard g12 are elevated, CPU steal on host node-77 around same time.

kai: probable hot-shard / hot-keying. repeated identical payloads can blow up cache/kv miss patterns and cause serialization in the embed pipeline. can we get an example payload size?

ava: example curl they shared: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large-v2","input":["lorem ipsum... same text repeated 1200x"] }'
```
small docs but massive duplication.

sam: checking internal metrics now. snippet from shard logs: 
```
2026-03-17T03:22:04Z shard=g12 tenant=tenant-riverside-9 queue_len=18 active_workers=2 kv_cache_hit=0.12 cpu_steal_pct=25
2026-03-17T03:23:01Z shard=g12 tenant=tenant-riverside-9 queue_len=24 active_workers=2 kv_cache_hit=0.09
```
looks like low kv cache hit rate, high queue.

marta: for immediate mitigation we can: 1) add tenant to short-lived priority reservation (ephemeral reserve) 2) add a soft per-tenant concurrency throttle to smooth bursts 3) enable dedupe/collapsing for identical inputs (fast path)

sam: created a temporary throttle rule to cap concurrency to 8 for tenant-riverside-9 via control-plane (applied). command used: 
```
PATCH https://control-plane.internal/v1/tenants/tenant-riverside-9/policies
{"throttle":{"concurrency_limit":8,"burst":16}}
```

ops-bot: CONFIG: throttle rule applied to tenant-riverside-9 by sam.

kai: I'll try rebalancing a few hot streams off shard g12 and enable prefix-kv caching for that tenant. This should reduce serialization. Running rebalance now.

sam: also created an ephemeral reservation (2x p4) pinned to tenant-riverside-9 for 20 minutes to drain backlog. ops-bot will report when ready. Expect p99 to drop in ~2-5 minutes after warmup.

rebecca-cs: I'm on the customer thread. told them we have a mitigation in progress (throttle + short reservation) and will follow up with root cause and credits. requested any quick repro steps so we can validate.

ava: once rebalance + reservation in place, can someone post p95/p99 numbers? want to confirm it's customer-visible improvement before closing.

ops-bot: RESERVATION: ephemeral-resv-338001 created for tenant-riverside-9 (2 p4s) by sam.

marta: initial numbers: before mitigation p95=320ms p99=2100ms; after reservation & throttle p95=180ms p99=420ms (5m window). kv_cache_hit improved to 0.52 after enabling prefix caching. queue_len dropped to <3.

sam: leaving the throttle rule in place for 1 hour then we'll relax and watch. filing follow-up ticket for shard rebalancing automation and hot-key detection.

rebecca-cs: customer confirmed improved job completion and will keep us posted. offered 5% credit for the downtime window.

kai: follow-ups: 1) instrument hot-key detector to auto-suggest dedupe 2) consider auto-prioritization policy for paid tiers 3) evaluate short TTL caching for identical embeddings.

ava: great work, closing loop here. will add notes to the support ticket and the follow-up SRE story. thanks all :thumbsup:
